title: Jared Verse was upset that Browns teammates didn't react when he took a cheap shot

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jared Verse was upset that Browns teammates didn't react when he took a cheap shot
sources.description: Browns defensive end Jared Verse was picked up and thrown to the ground by Steelers guard Mason McCormick on Sunday, and McCormick wasn't the only person Verse was upset with afterward.
